rule: Each figure is a square with two thick marks at one corner, one mark standing on each of the two edges that meet there, and the two marks never touch each other. In figure 3 the slash sits exactly on the corner and touches the vertical mark and both edges, so it breaks the pattern.
options_check: 1: two parallel slashes at bottom-left, one on each edge, not touching, fits. 2: same at top-left, fits. 3: slash sits on the corner and touches the vertical bar, does not fit. 4: vertical on top edge and slash lower on the right edge, separate, fits the touching rule though the marks are not parallel. 5: two parallel slashes at bottom-right, one on each edge, fits.
redraw_diffs: Redraw makes figures 3 and 4 look nearly identical (slash at the corner in both). In the original, figure 3 has the slash centred on the corner touching the vertical bar, while in figure 4 it is shifted down the right edge and separate from the bar. Redraw also loses mark thickness and the exact edge contacts, which decide the answer.
